1879073698.name: Screaming Shafts
1879073698.desc: You loose several arrows, carved and crafted to howl as they fly through the air.

1879096866.name: Scribe Manual: Bagpipes
1879096866.desc: This will scribe a manual to teach others to play the bagpipes. Doing so is much more taxing than training in person and requires a Blank Mentor Manual.

1879139746.name: Necrosis
1879139746.desc: You spit a necrotic poison which lowers your target's defences.

1879187362.name: Return to Enedwaith
1879187362.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Men of Enedwaith, you're able to quickly return to Nan Laeglin in Enedwaith. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879209890.name: Steed of the Hunter
1879209890.desc: A mount carrying all the trappings that are used and needed by the hunter.

1879210658.name: Contact Poison
1879210658.desc: The hatchling spits contact poison at their prey, with each application causing more severe damage.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Consumes Necrosis to apply max stacks.</rgb>

1879230498.name: Shadow Fangs
1879230498.desc: You rip at your target's flesh, tearing muscle and slowing his attacks. If the target was suffering from your crippling bite he begins taking damage over time.

1879240098.name: Instigate
1879240098.desc: You prefer to command the enemies' attention in battle and know how to instigate your opponent, generating threat over time.

1879241634.name: Anthem of the Red Dawn
1879241634.desc: Your music culminates in a great Anthem that brings forth the wrath of Rohan, the Red Dawn.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Alters Coda: instantly restores power to you and nearby fellowship members and war-steeds.</rgb>

1879243938.name: Improved Wild Attack
1879243938.desc: A single powerful melee attack. Critical Hits with this skill increase your Critical Hit chance for a short period of time.

1879244194.name: Intimidate
1879244194.desc: You let forth a mighty scream that frightens your target, forcing them to turn and flee from battle for a short time.

1879257890.name: Breakout
1879257890.desc: Break yourself out of any controlled state.

1879266850.name: Lossoth Strikes
1879266850.desc: Lothrandir has mastered the unarmed fighting style with which the Lossoth wage competitions of strength by the fire during the long dark of the winter months.

1879271970.name: Strength in Numbers
1879271970.desc: Call out to nearby allies and they respond in turn. You receive a heal-over-time that scales with the number of nearby allies, up to 6.

1879272098.name: Devastating Strike
1879272098.desc: Single-target attack that briefly increases the amount of damage enemies take.

1879277986.name: Concession and Rebuttal: Epic Conclusion
1879277986.desc: An enormously powerful lightning attack dealing +Damage per attunement consumed.\n \n Requires Battle Attunement.

1879288482.name: Stealthed Ambush with Flame
1879288482.desc: When attacking from stealth, a Warden can deliver a powerful opening volley.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Knockout replaced with a mount turn rate debuff</rgb>

1879354402.name: Phial of Galadriel
1879354402.desc: When held aloft, the phial of Galadriel's light can overcome even the greatest evils of Mordor.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Requires a moment of great need.</rgb>

1879365410.name: Lasgalen Grey Owl
1879365410.desc: Brings out a Lasgalen grey owl to keep you company.

1879368610.name: Picnic Steed
1879368610.desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.

1879406754.name: Scrapper Carrying Chicken
1879406754.desc: Carry around your prized scrapper chicken.

1879415714.name: Obvious Portent of Vitality
1879415714.desc: A quick burst of vitality, increasing your maximum morale and healing you.

1879457570.name: The Way of the Shield
1879457570.desc:
Wardens know that the surest path to victory is relying on the basics.

This skill changes to match the type of the last gambit used.

The Way of the Shield will consume all your Advanced Technique to improve your healing from Shield gambits for a brief time.

1879459362.name: Test Healing
1879459362.desc: Does fixed effect to test buffs and mitigations.

1879466274.name: Cut-over
1879466274.desc:
Make an aggressive cut.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:</rgb><rgb=#FF0000>
 Flèche applies latent damage.</rgb>

1879467298.name: Rummage: Knife
1879467298.desc: A serrated throwing knife, honed to a razer-sharp edge.

1879467810.name: Hearten (Any Form)
1879467810.desc: Words of encouragement help your allies through dark times.

1879486498.name: Water Buffalo Bull
1879486498.desc: Summons a noble water buffalo bull to accompany you on your travels.

1879490722.name: Shadow Cat
1879490722.desc: Summons a shadowy cat to accompany you on your travels.

1879491490.name: Sail to Urmâkh
1879491490.desc: Navigate to Urmâkh in Imhûlar in the Ikorbân Valley with nearby fellows.

1879492386.name: Sophisticated Magpie
1879492386.desc: Summons a delightful songbird to accompany you on your adventures.

1879506594.name: Conflagrate
1879506594.desc: Call forth a burst of fire upon your target, burning them and additional foes within the blast.

1879516450.name: Retaliate
1879516450.desc: When your enemies attempt to pin you down, you muscle forward with resolve, becoming more furious for each lash you bear.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Being slowed by a skill or effect will not allow this skill use.</rgb>

1879522082.name: Stink Ball
1879522082.desc: Throw a slimy ball of filth at someone you love.

1879529122.name: Drop the Gift of the Carrock

1879529506.name: Golden Fawn
1879529506.desc: Summons a golden fawn to accompany you on your travels.

1879530018.name: The Unseen Hunter
1879530018.desc: Vanish into the landscape, briefly entering stealth and empowering your bow skills, at the cost of some range.

1879530146.name: Uncontrolled Burn
1879530146.desc: Greatly increases Damage, Power Regen, and Attack Speed and makes you immune to slows and negative combat states while active, but dramatically reduces Incoming Healing and slowly drains Morale.
